name: sih_2026
description: Privacy-preserving on-device visual browser agent (SIH 2026). MV3 Chrome extension + local privacy firewall + planner server.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @sih/shared run build && npm --workspace @sih/server run build && npm --workspace @sih/extension run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @sih/shared run lint && npm --workspace @sih/server run lint && npm --workspace @sih/extension run lint
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:headed: npm run build && E2E_HEADED=1 playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts

author: shaanitdas
